<Subject 1>: attribute_transfer - transfer the woman body, face, hair style, hair color, clothing and makeup

detailed_description:

nodes.title: WORKFLOW NOTES
widgets_values:
1) Select a SOURCE VIDEO in LoadVideo.
2) Select the replacement CHARACTER IMAGE in LoadImage.
3) Diffusion model: minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_fp8_scaled.safetensors.
4) SAM3 checkpoint: sam3.1_multiplex_fp16.safetensors.
5) Text encoder: qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors.
6) Video VAE: minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors.
7) Audio VAE: minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors.
8) Turbo LoRA: minimax_h3_turbo_v4_step600_ema_pruned_comfyui.safetensors.
9) Attention: Sol scheduled -> Fused Modulation -> Chunk FeedForward (Sage nodes muted on RTX5090).
10) Comfy must run with --use-pytorch-cross-attention.
11) Output resolution follows the source-video dimensions.
12) SAM3 target is set to 'The woman'; change it when needed.

nodes.title: Character description
widgets_values: <Subject 1> should match <Picture 1> as closely as possible: preserve identity, facial features, hairstyle, hair color, body proportions, clothing and makeup.

nodes.title: Action
widgets_values: Preserve the action, pose changes, gestures and timing from <Video 1> as closely as possible. Keep natural motion and temporal consistency.

nodes.title: Scene description
widgets_values: Preserve the scene, background, lighting, composition, camera angle and camera movement from <Video 1>. Keep the spatial layout and timing consistent with the source video.

subgraphs.name: Video Segmentation (SAM3)
subgraphs.description: Segments video into temporally consistent masks using Meta SAM3 from text or interactive prompts.

nodes.title: Note: Prompt format
widgets_values:
Max tokens for this model is only 32, to separately prompt multiple subjects you can separate prompts with comma, and set the max amount of objects detected for each prompt with :N

For example above test prompt finds 2 cakes, one apron, 4 window panels
